2558-4659-8347--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-4659-8347--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Sela triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-6798-8201.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha, causing you to surveil 1
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4359-4770-5301-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1651-2034-3263-5261-8117.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting Raise the Alarm without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Raise the Alarm, creating two creature tokens that are also artifacts due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping both creature tokens, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing one creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped tokens, you may sacrifice any number of them to add infinite colorless mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7233.easyPrerequisites: Instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard have total mana value X or greater.
6495-6972-7233.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Inferno Project.
When Inferno Project dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7233.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-5131-5705-6797--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5705-6797--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2034-4478-6723-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

3179-4399-4506-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Auriok Champion trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4506-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

4613-5446-5805-7150.easyPrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
4613-5446-5805-7150.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
4613-5446-5805-7150.description:
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens, which each enter with a +1/+1 counter on them due to Gev.
Repeat from step 3, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

1982-2018-4053.description:
Cast Sidisi by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Sidisi enters, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Sidisi dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Sidisi's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, causing you to search your library for a card and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Sidisi from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.

2617-7150-7638.easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
2617-7150-7638.description:
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying The Mind Stone's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of The Mind Stone's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-7124-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
2921-7124-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2921-7124-7358.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat each combat phase.

4659-5346-6753-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of it due to Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Improvised Arsenal tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Crime Novelist triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

222-527-4460-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4460-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

6529-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

5470-6188-7060.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
5470-6188-7060.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

3661-4053-5231-6989.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Screaming Nemesis instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

Activate Joraga Treespeaker by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Joraga Treespeaker.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

3490-4616-4659-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3490-4616-4659-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

841-4544-6797--106.easyPrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-4544-6797--106.description:
Play a land card.
Dúnedain Rangers and the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger.
Resolve the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the creature token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
841-4544-6797--106.notes: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

5686-6188-6591--85.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
5686-6188-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Fear of Missing Out as attackers.
Fear of Missing Out's second ability triggers, untapping Squall and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and the ability granted to it by Doom Weaver each trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia and Doom Weaver's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, repairing it and the persist creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1, creating a Blood token.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

When the Robot enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1762-2144-3613-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wilhelt, adding {U}.
When Wilhelt dies, Myrkul triggers, exiling Wilhelt from your graveyard and creating a token copy of Wilhelt that is an enchantment.
Cast Dress Down by paying {1}{U}.
When Dress Down enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Zombie, adding one mana of any color.
When the Zombie dies, the Wilhelt token triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token with decayed, which becomes a 2/2 Zombie without decayed due to Dress Down.
Repeat from step 5.

1558-4248-4840.description:
Deal combat damage with Harnessed Snubhorn.
Harnessed Snubhorn triggers, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and sacrificing the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3199-3209-4772.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You control at least two untapped creatures, one of which must be green.
3199-3209-4772.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by tapping a green creature and any other creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat step 4.

2385-3368-3681-4703.notablePrerequisites:
Grafted Exoskeleton attached to Brallin.
You have at least seven cards in hand.
2385-3368-3681-4703.description:
Cast Change of Fortune by paying {3}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate by paying {1}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Change of Fortune.
Resolve the copy of Change of Fortune, discarding your hand and drawing cards equal to the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
Brallin triggers for each card discarded, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself and giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Resolve the original Change of Fortune, discarding your hand and drawing cards equal to the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
Brallin triggers for each card discarded, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself and giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

721-2724-3879.description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Portal of Sanctuary by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
